notes: Markets rates load again, memory and tool selection are fixed, and updates now show you what is changing before you install.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.3

sections.title: Markets
items: Live rates are back. Indian indices, currencies and commodities now load on the Markets page, not just crypto.
Prices refresh on their own while the page is open.

sections.title: Memory and tools
items: It remembers what you tell it again. Recall was falling back to a basic word match before, so older details went missing.
It now picks the right tool for what you ask instead of guessing, so writing a note, adding a holding or checking a price lands the first time.

sections.title: Updates
items: Before you install, you now see exactly what is changing, grouped by area, with a plain note on what happens to your data.
You can turn on automatic updates in Settings, under System, so new versions install quietly overnight.
The update notice stays until you close it, and only shows again for a newer version.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
